content_zh:
李磊迷迷糊糊的好像做了一个梦，但那梦竟如此的真实，准确来说那是一个秘境!

    此时李磊正打量着秘境周围。

    这秘境是一个暗紫色的空间，四周除了一团团紫色雾气之外什么都没有。

    “这是秘境吗？什么都没有!”

    李磊发现秘境这般如此后略感失望无奈的摇了摇头。

    “呵呵呵！年轻人，你终于来了”

    忽然弥漫在秘境四周的紫色雾气竟聚集在了一起，融合成了一个巨型紫色气团。

    看到这般情形李磊便开始仔细观察那个巨型紫色气团，他是想看看这个气团里面有没有宝贝，可李磊无论怎么观察，这个气团依旧是那般神秘。

    “没有宝贝吗，不应该啊”李磊喃喃自语道。

    “哈哈哈，年轻人，我可不是什么宝贝”

    忽然那个声音又出现了，之前那个声音李磊没有理会，那是因为李磊认为这个空间真的只有自己一个人，如果听到另外一个声音就是幻听，那现在可就不同了，幻听可不会这么真实。

    忽然那巨型紫色气团竟消失不见了，取而代之的是一个紫色虚影。

    这个虚影和刚才那巨大的气团比起来非常的渺小，但李磊可以看出这虚影的的确确是那巨型紫色气团所形成的。
content_en:
Li Lei felt as if he had a dream, but the dream was so real. To be precise, it was a secret realm!

At this time, Li Lei was looking around the secret realm.

This secret realm is a dark purple space, surrounded by nothing but clouds of purple mist.

"Is this a secret realm? There is nothing!"

Li Lei was slightly disappointed when he discovered that the secret realm was like this and shook his head helplessly.

"Hehehe! Young man, you are finally here."

Suddenly, the purple mist that filled the surroundings of the secret realm gathered together and merged into a giant purple air mass.

Seeing this situation, Li Lei began to carefully observe the giant purple air mass. He wanted to see if there was any treasure in the air mass, but no matter how Li Lei looked, the air mass was still so mysterious.

"Don't you have a baby? It shouldn't be," Li Lei murmured to himself.

"Hahaha, young man, I am not a treasure."

Suddenly the voice appeared again. Li Lei ignored the previous voice. That was because Li Lei believed that he was the only one in this space. If hearing another voice was an auditory hallucination, it was different now. Auditory hallucinations would not be so real.

Suddenly, the giant purple air mass disappeared and was replaced by a purple shadow.

This phantom was very small compared to the huge air ball just now, but Li Lei could see that the phantom was indeed formed by the giant purple air ball.
